1	import React from 'react';
2	import {
3	  Accordion,
4	  AccordionItem,
5	  AccordionButton,
6	  AccordionPanel,
7	  chakra,
8	  useMultiStyleConfig,
9	} from '@chakra-ui/react';
10	import { ChevronDownIcon, ChevronUpIcon } from 'app/components/icons';
11	
12	const ZIMM_ACCORDION_RECIPE = 'ZimmAccordion';
13	
14	export type ZimmAccordionItem = {
15	  /** Stable identifier — matches `defaultExpandedId` and acts as the React key. */
16	  id: string;
17	  /**
18	   * Group label shown in the header. Rendered uppercase via the `textStyle="productNames"`
19	   * design-system entry (see typography.ts), so callers pass Title Case ("Colour", not
20	   * "COLOUR") — this keeps i18n content faithful.
21	   */
22	  label: string;
23	  /**
24	   * Facet UI rendered inside the panel when expanded. SFCC-847 stops at the group
25	   * container — the real facet content (radio buttons, colour swatches, size chips, etc.)
26	   * is SFCC-108's scope.
27	   */
28	  content: React.ReactNode;
29	  /**
30	   * Optional content rendered directly under the header only when the item is collapsed —
31	   * use for a compact summary the shopper needs to see at a glance without expanding the
32	   * accordion (e.g. the current selection chips for a filter facet). Hidden when the item
33	   * is expanded so the full content in `content` takes over. Rendered outside Chakra's
34	   * AccordionPanel, so it does not participate in the expand/collapse animation.
35	   * Leave undefined for accordions with no summary.
36	   */
37	  alwaysVisibleContent?: React.ReactNode;
38	};
39	
40	type ZimmAccordionProps = {
41	  items: readonly ZimmAccordionItem[];
42	  /**
43	   * Which item is open on first render. Uncontrolled — the user can toggle from here on
44	   * without informing the parent.
45	   */
46	  defaultExpandedId?: string;
47	};
48	
49	/**
50	 * Single-open accordion group — a Zimmermann-styled wrapper around Chakra's Accordion
51	 * primitive. Delivers SFCC-847's accordion behaviour: only one item expanded at a time
52	 * (matches AC #5 and the DS 2026 Figma audited 2026-09-16, node
53	 * wPiWmZZOVKnrENUWk2XWWm/40003890:151742 which shows exactly one accordion expanded),
54	 * expanding a new item collapses the previously expanded one, and each header exposes
55	 * `aria-expanded` reflecting its state (unchanged from Chakra's own `AccordionButton`).
56	 *
57	 * The chevron swaps ChevronDown (collapsed) ↔ ChevronUp (expanded) using the render-prop
58	 * form of `AccordionItem`. A CSS-only 180° rotation on a single glyph could animate
59	 * between them, but Zimmermann's own chevron pair (icons/zimm.tsx nodes 40002082:49961 and
60	 * 40002128:29217) are drawn as distinct shapes — swapping is faithful, rotating isn't.
61	 *
62	 * @param props see ZimmAccordionProps
63	 */
64	export const ZimmAccordion = ({ items, defaultExpandedId }: ZimmAccordionProps) => {
65	  const styles = useMultiStyleConfig(ZIMM_ACCORDION_RECIPE, {});
66	  // `findIndex` returns -1 when the id isn't in `items`. Chakra's `defaultIndex={-1}` logs a
67	  // "out of range" warning at dev-time; coercing to `undefined` instead falls back to
68	  // Chakra's own default (nothing expanded).
69	  const initialIndex = items.findIndex((item) => item.id === defaultExpandedId);
70	  const defaultIndex = initialIndex >= 0 ? initialIndex : undefined;
71	
72	  return (
73	    <Accordion allowToggle defaultIndex={defaultIndex} sx={styles.root}>
74	      {items.map((item) => (
75	        <AccordionItem key={item.id} sx={styles.item}>
76	          {({ isExpanded }) => (
77	            <>
78	              <AccordionButton sx={styles.header}>
79	                <chakra.span textStyle="productNames" sx={styles.label}>
80	                  {item.label}
81	                </chakra.span>
82	                {isExpanded ? (
83	                  <ChevronUpIcon boxSize="var(--zimm-icon-size-xl)" />
84	                ) : (
85	                  <ChevronDownIcon boxSize="var(--zimm-icon-size-xl)" />
86	                )}
87	              </AccordionButton>
88	              {!isExpanded && item.alwaysVisibleContent && (
89	                <chakra.div sx={styles.alwaysVisible}>{item.alwaysVisibleContent}</chakra.div>
90	              )}
91	              <AccordionPanel sx={styles.panel}>{item.content}</AccordionPanel>
92	            </>
93	          )}
94	        </AccordionItem>
95	      ))}
96	    </Accordion>
97	  );
98	};
99

1	// SFCC-847 drawer/content/filters — accordion recipe. Tokens sourced from the Zimmermann
2	// Design System 2026 Figma (node wPiWmZZOVKnrENUWk2XWWm/40003890:151736 and /40003890:151742,
3	// audited 2026-09-16). Divider colour resolves to `alias/color/border/secondary` in Figma
4	// which binds to `#dddddd` — surfaced in this codebase as
5	// `--zimm-color-border-tertiary` (see foundation/colour.ts `border.tertiary`). Figma's N+1
6	// divider pattern (7 dividers for 6 accordions: top + between + bottom) is reproduced by
7	// giving each item both `borderTop` and `borderBottom`, with no `_first`/`_last` override.
8	
9	export const ZimmAccordion = {
10	  parts: ['root', 'item', 'header', 'label', 'alwaysVisible', 'panel'],
11	  baseStyle: {
12	    root: {
13	      width: '100%',
14	    },
15	    // Every item carries both top and bottom borders so the accordion group reads as N+1
16	    // dividers between headers, matching Figma. Chakra's own AccordionItem defaults are
17	    // overridden here rather than layered on: the default `1px solid` uses the theme border
18	    // colour, not the drawer-specific tertiary token.
19	    item: {
20	      borderTop: 'var(--zimm-border-width-default) solid var(--zimm-color-border-tertiary)',
21	      borderBottom: 'var(--zimm-border-width-default) solid var(--zimm-color-border-tertiary)',
22	      // Collapse the shared edge between adjacent items so a single 1px line renders instead
23	      // of a doubled 2px seam. Only the last item keeps its own borderBottom.
24	      _notLast: {
25	        borderBottom: 'none',
26	      },
27	    },
28	    // Chakra's AccordionButton is a real <button>; these sx overrides layer over its defaults
29	    // (transparent bg, blackAlpha _hover, block layout). Cursor: pointer stays Chakra-owned.
30	    // paddingBlock 20px per row yields ~41px between adjacent header baselines (20 + 1px
31	    // border + 20), matching Figma's `Accordion group` gap-with-divider rhythm.
32	    header: {
33	      display: 'flex',
34	      alignItems: 'center',
35	      justifyContent: 'space-between',
36	      width: '100%',
37	      paddingBlock: 'var(--zimm-scale-l)',
38	      paddingInline: 0,
39	      _hover: {
40	        backgroundColor: 'transparent',
41	      },
42	      _focusVisible: {
43	        // audit-allow: 2px matches Chakra's default focus-ring outline width; no dedicated
44	        // Zimmermann token for outline width (only offset + composite).
45	        outline: '2px solid var(--zimm-color-border-focus)',
46	        outlineOffset: 'var(--zimm-focus-ring-offset-default)',
47	      },
48	    },
49	    label: {
50	      // textTransform intentionally NOT set here — `textStyle="productNames"` (applied in
51	      // index.tsx) already carries `textTransform: 'uppercase'` from the design system.
52	      color: 'var(--zimm-color-text-default)',
53	      flex: '1 0 0',
54	      textAlign: 'left',
55	    },
56	    // Rendered directly below the header regardless of expanded state. Padding matches the
57	    // panel's so a facet's chips align visually with the options list below when expanded.
58	    alwaysVisible: {
59	      paddingBlock: 'var(--zimm-scale-s)',
60	      paddingInline: 0,
61	    },
62	    panel: {
63	      paddingBlock: 'var(--zimm-scale-s)',
64	      paddingInline: 0,
65	      // Constrain children to available width. Without this, Stack/Flex children can expand
66	      // beyond the drawer's bounds, causing horizontal overflow (audited 2026-09-16: Stack
67	      // was 634px on 375px viewport). Width 100% + border-box ensures children don't exceed
68	      // their parent's computed width.
69	      width: '100%',
70	      boxSizing: 'border-box',
71	      overflow: 'hidden',
72	    },
73	  },
74	};
75

26	  onApply: () => void;

36	 *

39	 * SFCC-108's scope and is supplied by the caller via `facetGroups[i].content`.
40	 *
41	 * `size="large"` on the CLEAR/APPLY buttons resolves to 52px via `zimmButton.css.ts`

45	 *
46	 * @param props see ZimmFiltersDrawerContentProps
47	 */
48	export const ZimmFiltersDrawerContent = ({
49	  facetGroups,
50	  initialExpandedId,
51	  onClear,
52	  onApply,
53	  clearLabel = 'CLEAR',
54	  applyLabel = 'APPLY',
55	}: ZimmFiltersDrawerContentProps) => {
56	  const styles = useMultiStyleConfig(ZIMM_FILTERS_DRAWER_CONTENT_RECIPE, {});
57	
58	  return (

18	  baseStyle: {

21	      flexDirection: 'column',
22	      // Flows naturally with content (Figma content-container is shrink-0, not height-filled).

## a11y-defect-confirmed

**1. "Accessible filter announcements" (PR summary claim) do not exist anywhere in this diff.**
`grep -n "aria-live"` against the full `pr117.diff` and against every new/touched file returns zero matches. `product-list/index.tsx`'s `applyFilters`, chip-removal `onRemove` handlers, and `SelectedChipRow`'s pagination `onOffsetChange` all trigger client-side `navigate()`/state changes with no live region anywhere in the render tree.
- Fails **WCAG 4.1.3 Status Messages (2.1 AA)** — pressing APPLY changes the product count and grid with no non-visual signal; a screen-reader user gets silence.
- Also directly contradicts SFCC-847 AC #1 ("no violations").
- **CONFIRMED** (exhaustive grep, zero matches, base worktree also has none — not a regression, but the PR's own stated deliverable is simply absent).
- 🔴 must-fix. **ONE-OFF** (one missing feature, wide-reaching effect: APPLY navigation, chip removal, chip pagination all lack it).

**2. Category facet uses checkbox semantics for a mutually-exclusive (radio) selection.**
`overrides/app/pages/product-list/index.tsx:711-727` — the Category list renders base Chakra `<Checkbox isChecked={pendingCategoryId === id} onChange={() => handleCategoryChange(id)}>`. Selecting a category always sets a single `pendingCategoryId`, silently un-checking whatever was previously checked (`handleCategoryChange` never allows two categories selected at once). A screen reader announces each row as an independent checkbox ("Dresses, checkbox, checked") with no indication that checking "Tops" next silently unchecked "Dresses."
- Fails **WCAG 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value** — the exposed role (checkbox = independent toggle) doesn't match actual behaviour (radio = mutually exclusive).
- **CONFIRMED** via source (`handleCategoryChange`'s single `pendingCategoryId` state, `isChecked` computed from equality not inclusion).
- 🔴 must-fix. **ONE-OFF** (Colour/Material/Size/etc. correctly use real multi-select, so this isn't a repeated pattern — it's isolated to Category).

**3. Empty/zero-option states render with no messaging, at three levels — confirmed by source trace, not visual.**
- Whole drawer: `filterFacetGroups` (`product-list/index.tsx:828-831`) evaluates to `[]` when `resolvedCategoryOptions.length === 0` and `activeRefinements` is empty (e.g. a zero-refinement search result). `ZimmAccordion` then maps over `[]` → the drawer opens to a title, a close button, blank body, then CLEAR/APPLY, with nothing explaining why.
- One facet: `ZimmCheckbox`'s `if (hitCount === 0 && !isChecked) return null` (`zimmCheckbox/index.tsx:26`) can hide every row in a `ZimmCheckboxGroup` at once — that accordion's header still shows a working chevron/`aria-expanded`, but expanding it reveals nothing.
- Size facet: `SizeChipRow`'s identical per-value `hitCount === 0` guard (`zimmSizeFilter/index.tsx:22`) can empty out the whole 4-column grid the same way, with a nested sub-heading (e.g. "Accessories") sometimes left with an empty grid underneath it.
- This is a **Graceful Degradation** gap per AGENTS.md, not a crash — it degrades to blank, it doesn't break the page — but nothing tells a shopper (sighted or AT) why a facet or the whole drawer is empty.
- **CONFIRMED** via source trace of the actual filtering conditions.
- 🟡 should-fix. **UNIFORM** (identical "silently empty, no message" shape recurs at all three levels).

## needs-browser-confirmation

**4. `ZimmCheckbox` row height is well under the 24×24 CSS px minimum on its own — likely saved only by an undocumented reliance on SC 2.5.8's Spacing exception.**

Arithmetic (all values traced to source, not eyeballed):

| Component | Height math | Width | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| Size-filter chip (`ZimmSizeFilter`→`ZimmButton size="medium"`→Chakra size `sm`) | `h: var(--zimm-size-action-height-md)` = **40px** (`sizes.ts` `actionSizes.height.md`) | `px: 20px` each side + label text | **Clean** — 40px ≫ 24px |
| `ZimmSelectedChip` remove target (whole chip is the button) | `height: var(--zimm-scale-2xl)` = **32px** (`spacing.ts` `2xl: 2rem`) | `minWidth: var(--zimm-scale-5xl)` = **80px** | **Clean** — 32×80 ≫ 24×24 |
| Chip pagination arrows (`ZimmButton variant="icon"`, no `size` passed → Chakra size key `icon`) | `zimmButton.css.ts` `sizes.icon`: `minH: var(--zimm-scale-xl)` = **24px** exactly, `h:'auto'`, padding hard-zeroed by Chakra's `IconButton` | `minW: 24px` | **Clean, exactly at the floor** — pre-existing, unmodified by this PR, already comment-flagged as "WCAG 2.2 AA SC 2.5.8" in `zimmButton.css.ts`. Not new. |
| `ZimmCheckbox` row (checkbox box + gap + label, one `<label>` per Chakra's `checkbox.js:501`) | Checkbox control: Chakra default `sizes.md` → `sizes.4` = **16px**. Label: `textStyle="navigation"` → `fontSize: fontSizes['3xs']` = **12px**, `lineHeight: 'normal'` (≈14-17px browser-computed, font-dependent). Row height = `max(16px, ~14-17px)` via `rootStyles.alignItems:'center'` ≈ **16-17px total**. No padding/minHeight anywhere in `ZimmCheckbox`/`ZimmCheckboxGroup` adds vertical space. | full row width (label text) | **Under 24px on its own** — but `ZimmCheckboxGroup`'s `<Stack spacing="var(--zimm-scale-m)">` (16px) puts row *centres* ≈ 8+16+8 = **32px apart**, clearing SC 2.5.8's Spacing-exception threshold (24px). |

- Fails 2.5.8 in isolation; **likely passes overall via the Spacing exception** — but nothing in the code documents that this is a deliberate exception being relied on (contrast with `zimmButton.css.ts`'s icon-size comment, which explicitly names the SC it's satisfying). A future change to the Stack's gap, or wrapping checkboxes into a 2-column grid, would silently create a real, uncaught violation.
- **PLAUSIBLE** (token math is exact; the ±3px band from "normal" line-height on Futura Round, and the true circle-intersection test, need a DevTools computed-height check to close out). Settling measurement: open `ZimmCheckboxGroup`'s story, DevTools → computed `height` of one `.chakra-checkbox` row and the `margin-top` Chakra's `Stack` actually applies between two.
- 🟡 should-fix (document the reliance, or bump the row to a real 24px). **UNIFORM** — same shape hits every checkbox-based facet (Colour, Material, Sleeve Length, Availability).

**5. Accordion collapse can drop keyboard/AT focus into the void — traced through Chakra's own source, not reproduced live.**
`@chakra-ui/accordion`'s `getPanelProps` (`use-accordion.js:200-212`) sets `hidden: !isOpen`, but `AccordionPanel` (`accordion-panel.js:72-74`) **deletes** that `hidden` attribute whenever `reduceMotion` is false (the default, and `ZimmAccordion` never sets it) — visibility is instead owned entirely by `@chakra-ui/transition`'s `Collapse` (`collapse.js`), which animates height to 0 and only applies `display:'none'` in `transitionEnd.exit`, ~100-300ms after collapse starts. Neither `ZimmAccordion` nor `ZimmFiltersDrawerContent` calls `.focus()` anywhere.
Concrete repro path: shopper Tabs into an open accordion's checkbox, then (without Tabbing away) **clicks** a different accordion's header with the mouse — a real, common mixed-modality action. The first accordion's panel starts collapsing while the checkbox still holds focus; once `display:none` lands, the browser silently blurs to `document.body` with no focus/blur event fired to anything visible.
`ZimmDrawer` does wrap everything in Chakra's real `Drawer`/`ModalFocusScope` (confirmed, `zimmDrawer/index.tsx:168`), which may re-capture focus before it reaches `document.body` — but even caught, it lands focus somewhere arbitrary inside the drawer, not somewhere contextually sensible (e.g., back on the header that was just interacted with).
- Relevant to **WCAG 2.4.3 Focus Order** (2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured doesn't quite fit — nothing is visually obscuring focus, it's disappearing).
- **PLAUSIBLE** — the mechanism is confirmed line-by-line from `node_modules` source; the *final landing spot* (body vs. FocusLock-recaptured-somewhere) needs a real browser: open the `ZimmFiltersDrawerContent` "InsideDrawer" story, Tab to a checkbox inside "Colour," then mouse-click the "Size" header, then check `document.activeElement`.
- No story or test anywhere exercises this — confirmed by reading all 6 components' test/story files: every interaction test uses `.click()` or `aria-expanded` assertions, none simulate "focus is on X, click Y" cross-item.
- 🟡 should-fix. **UNIFORM** — this is inherent to the shared `ZimmAccordion` atom, so it will recur in every future consumer (a size-guide accordion, FAQ accordion), not just this drawer.

**6. `ZimmAccordion`'s chevron icons have no `aria-hidden`.**
`zimmAccordion/index.tsx:82-86` renders `<ChevronUpIcon boxSize=... />` / `<ChevronDownIcon .../>` with no `aria-hidden` prop. `ChevronDownIcon`/`ChevronUpIcon` (`overrides/app/components/icons/zimm.tsx:102-124`) are plain `createIcon()` results — Chakra's `Icon` only defaults `focusable={false}` (an SVG-specific, keyboard-only attribute), never `aria-hidden`. Every *other* decorative icon this same PR touches gets it explicitly (`ZimmSelectedChip`'s close icon: `aria-hidden={true}`; `ZimmButton`'s `iconLeading`/`iconTrailing` spans: `aria-hidden={true}`) — this is the one place the PR's own established pattern wasn't applied.
- Touches **WCAG 1.1.1/4.1.2**-adjacent territory: some browser/AT combinations expose an unlabeled inline `<svg>` as an extra "image"/"graphic" node, so a header could announce as "Colour, image, button" instead of just "Colour, button."
- **CONFIRMED** the attribute is absent from source; the AT-announcement consequence is **PLAUSIBLE** (behaviour is genuinely browser/AT-pair dependent — needs VoiceOver/NVDA spot-check on the rendered story to settle).
- 🟡 should-fix. **ONE-OFF** (the rest of this exact PR does it correctly).

## not-a-problem (checked and clean)

- **Accordion core semantics** (`aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`, `role="region"` + `aria-labelledby` on the panel, Arrow/Home/End header navigation, Enter/Space toggle) are 100% delegated to Chakra's `useAccordionItem`/`AccordionButton`/`AccordionPanel` (confirmed reading `use-accordion.js`) — matches the WAI-ARIA Accordion pattern out of the box. AC #2 ("announced with label and expanded/collapsed state") is met.
- **Only-one-expanded-at-a-time** is genuinely enforced (Chakra's default single-`index` behaviour, `allowToggle` only adds "click-to-close-the-open-one") and has real interaction-tested coverage (`index.stories.tsx`'s `OnlyOneExpandedAtATime` play function, clicking Beta and asserting Alpha's `aria-expanded` flips to false). AC #5 met.
- **Full-keyboard reachability of the drawer** (AC #3): close button → accordion headers (only the one open facet's content is ever in the tab sequence, since collapsed panels settle to `display:none`) → CLEAR → APPLY. Structurally sound, independent of finding 5 above.
- **`ZimmSizeFilter`'s `role="checkbox"`/`aria-checked` on `ZimmButton`**: modelled as a discriminated union (`{role?:never;ariaChecked?:never} | {role:'checkbox'|'radio';ariaChecked:boolean}`) so state can't be supplied without a role or vice versa; spread onto a real `<button>`, so Enter/Space work natively regardless of the ARIA role overlay; `ariaLabel` correctly carries "Add/Remove filter: {size}" while the visible `label` stays the terse size code.
- **`ZimmSelectedChip` is a real `<button type="button">`**, not a div-pretending-to-be-a-button — confirmed both from source and from its own test (`chip.tagName toBe('BUTTON')`), so `.claude/rules/components.md`'s role/tabIndex/onKeyDown requirement for non-native elements doesn't apply here; it's already native.
- **Chip pagination a11y tree** (item 5 of the brief): `SelectedChipRow` renders only `visibleChips` via `.slice()` — paged-out chips are excluded from the DOM entirely, not CSS-clipped. Sighted and AT users see/reach an identical set, so there's no 1.3.1/4.1.2 "visible-but-unreachable" mismatch. Keyboard users reach page 2 via the real `Previous chips`/`Next chips` buttons (`disabled` boundary-gated correctly at `canPageLeft`/`canPageRight`); focus stays on the Next/Previous button across a page change (nothing removes it), so there's no focus loss on paging — only the missing page-change announcement, already covered under finding 1.
- **`ZimmDrawer`'s foundation** (`Drawer`/`useModalContext`/`ModalFocusScope`) is genuinely Chakra's real dialog/focus-trap machinery, not reimplemented — confirmed reading `zimmDrawer/index.tsx`. This is the correct base for AC #3.
- **AC #4 (CLEAR's accessible name)**: `aria-label={ariaLabel ?? label}` = "CLEAR" — plain but sufficient in the context of a dialog already labelled "FILTER BY."
